'''Cemeille din Selaan Long Eyes''' is an ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' [[Sailmistress]] on the darter ''[[Wind Racer]]''.

== Appearance ==
She is young, tall and lean.

== Activities ==
She interrupts a meeting with the ''Atha'an Miere'' [[First Twelve]] with the news that the [[Amayar]] have committed mass suicide.
